description.en: Original static stylized-inspired urasterella; evidence-informed teaching art, not a strict scientific reconstruction.
description.zh: urasterella 原创静态风格化教学美术；参考基本形态，并非严格科考复原。

author: Leon Made This / s010s

sources.title: Virtual Collection: Class Asteroidea - Digital Atlas of Ancient Life
sources.notes: Group-level shell/skeleton form and explicitly named fossil specimens only. Modern specimens on the same page do not establish prehistoric occurrence. Original inventory verification: opened. This does not assert a new full source reading.

sources.title: Urasterella sp. — PRI 76788
sources.notes: Named Devonian specimen from Tompkins County, New York; do not mistake surrounding rock dimension for the animal measurement or reuse its source mesh.

artistic_choices: Suggested palette: muted coral-rust and warm gray
Nominal size, proportions, pose, missing fine parts and simplified detail are artistic.
Tiny subjects need close placement or an explicit creative display-scale choice; do not promise readability from a distant island camera.
Opaque or economical portable materials are preferred. Fine translucent/vein/feather detail is optional when it does not survive normal viewing.

nominal_scale.kind: art-direction choice, not a newly measured fossil dimension

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed stylized-inspired static teaching art. Color, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified fine anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的静态风格化启发教学美术；颜色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化细部属于艺术选择，并非严格科学复原。
